big-adventure.specific_finding: The summary says the first player to reach the final space wins. The original current Russian publisher reference instead requires a compulsory stop on the gum space, makes that player immovable there, and tells them to roll on their turns to try opening the finish-safe. The original box back explicitly says winning requires reaching the gum and opening that safe. Arrival alone therefore does not win; removing the separate safe attempt changes the ending and other players’ opportunities. Specific MAJOR for this covered current publisher ending only. Exact successful-roll target and other board rules remain unavailable; no first-edition/full-summary audit or body repair.
